question: Approve the DRC-4587 issue rewrite and the milestone correction for writing to Linear, and approve the seven acceptance criteria and the declared surface as the contract implementation will be held to.

artifacts.summary: Triage re-checked every figure in the issue against main and ran each oracle it wrote into an acceptance criterion, so the pre-change values are measured rather than asserted. Three findings changed the issue: a second structural move acceptance 2 always required, a recon-reported selector collision that does not exist, and a third dead token the issue missed. The milestone needs one correction, because it states the APCA figures as measured fact and nothing in the repository can reproduce them.
